name: Tokitsukaze and Good 01-String (easy version)
justification: Satisfying observation collapses it to counting mismatched pairs; one-line answer.
solution_sketch: All block lengths even iff s[2i]==s[2i+1] for every pair. Each bad pair costs exactly 1 change, so answer = number of positions i with s[2i]!=s[2i+1].
